results.direct: Ask Vivek Bot to explain the setup part to you in a few sentences.
results.asked: Could you explain the setup part to me in just a few sentences?
results.answer: Sure. It's a point mass launched from the origin with initial speed v naught at angle theta. Gravity acts downward and air resistance is ignored, so the horizontal acceleration is zero and the vertical acceleration is minus g. That gives the starting conditions: position at zero, and initial velocities v naught cosine theta horizontally and v naught sine theta vertically. From there, you integrate to get position as a function of time.
results.truth: It was explaining the setup when the screen was moved to part 2 of 3 by someone else. A good answer finishes or wraps up its point coherently, and does not claim it moved the screen itself.
